notes.title: Halloween Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Wondering what exactly was changed in the latest update? Well wonder no more!

Update notes/fixes:

- Post-Processing
	- Motion blur, ambient occultation, and bloom have been added
	- Text has also ben reworked to be clearer and scalable

- School Additions
	- Can find a cassette player and a few tapes around that play music
	- School desks and chairs have been updated and rearranged
		- The same can be said for teacher desk and chairs as well
	- Third hallway added after monster hallway containing dumpsters
	- Gym now has windows & Science Room has revamped windows
- Added windows to back hallway
	- Increased size of and improved Storage Room
	- Plenty of new models have been introduced

- Main Menu Refresh
	- Cleaned up and enhanced logo
	- Changed text to X-tefer Productions logo
	- Changed background picture
	- Right-aligned main menu buttons
	- Added vynl icon for Music Menu

- New features
	- Small Mode Cheat: use F9/F10 to toggle in-game height
	- The wrench now spawns in three different locations
		- Mr. Giggles, the handtruck, and box stack as well
		- Pencils spawn in 3 each

	- The power can be re-enabled via the Storage Room
	- The water in the Storage and Science room is electrified

- Player Changes
	- Increased camera shake while running & increased footstep sound frequency while walking

- Music Changes
	- Select Mode now has a simplified music track
	- Switched out Unwanted Corridors with a more “hopeful” Advant Hallways
- Added sounds to cheats

- Improvements
	- Skybox is now clearer and moves
	- Changed flashlight sound
	- Changed "It knows you're here" picture to Elshwood logo
	- Adjusted lighting on Normal mode to give a more saturated look
	- Windows are now see-through both ways
	- Particle system (air particles) have seen numerous improvements
		- Area of effect has been doubled & the are way more particles
		- Color of particles have been darkened
	- Added black bars to cutscene
	- Dying now flashes the screen red and plays an audio cue

- Misc fixes
	- Realigned side hall water fountain
	- Cleared up Mode Select icons
	- Improved school floor tiling
	- Changed cracked wall texture by English Room
	- Changed Totally Normal Poems model

Thanks so much for playing!

notes.title: Content Update #3 is Here!
notes.notes:
Welcome back to The Game of Unknown! Moving kind of got in the way of things and really messed with my original plan. I was supposed to update this in late May/early June and then again in October, but clearly that didn’t happen now did it?

This update is larger than the past two and contains an across-the-board feature list. In fact, that is why even the patch notes had to be presented in this manner, as there is just too much! Let’s run by them, shall we?

[b]Post-Processing[/b]
One of the first things to take notice is the addition if many post-processing effects added, mainly bloom, motion blur, and ambient occultation to really make everything pop! Text is sharper and has shadows on it as well.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42121869/eca3826c0b95a7a81c809214a2c8f74cf62fc55b.png[/img]

[b]Menu Mayhem[/b]
I guess the real first thing you will see is the newly refreshed main menu, with a new background and clearer text. The pause menu has been improved with all of the cheats being clearly presented on the left side of the screen, and the cursor will no longer disappear unlike before.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42121869/f3b1c0a6b8bfcd4b10da493f93c27de9c0b17297.png[/img]

[b]School Additions[/b]
The school has seen a bunch of new additions and improvements. A new hallway has been added, more windows are available, and there is more to see outside as well! Not to mention the Storage Room has seen some improvements…

[b]Storage Room[/b]
Not only is the Storage Room bigger, but it’s also taken on some more damage, with electrified water everywhere! Take care to watch your step, as coming in contact with the hazardous water will result in instant death! The Storage Room is also where you can find the power switch, for those brave enough to navigate the treacherous waters in the pitch-black building will be rewarded with the power being resupplied!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42121869/da402c7fea8f393229c8219a50644575165ab81a.png[/img]

[b]Randomized Spawning[/b]
Now each playthrough of the game will have certain items spawn in different locations…

[b]Haloween Mode[/b]
Just a moody reskin of Normal Mode, this mode should sure get you into the spirit!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42121869/8b0a550fd1aad499231a377a72a743ba231b7bff.png[/img]

[b]Misc. Improvements[/b]
So many  random things have been added or changed that it would be pointless to name everything. However, the full list of everything as a list is down below. Some stuff including more responsive running, enhanced particle system, new/updated models, and more!

Again, thanks so much for playing, it really means so much!

notes.title: Update V 1.03 this October!
notes.notes:
Well hello there everyone! First off thank you so much for playing The Game of Unknown and for taking the time to read this post! It really means a lot!

If you have been following X-tefer Productions on Twitter and/or Facebook, you would have already known that work was still being done on The Game of Unknown.

Didn't know about the socials? We fear no more!

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/xtefer]https://twitter.com/xtefer [/url]
Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/xtefer]https://www.facebook.com/xtefer[/url] 

This October, just in time for Halloween, an update will come out to The Game of Unknown. Version 1.03 in fact. It's quite the big update!

Since the game came out on April 7th, we have seen two updates. The first added more to the cafeteria and fixed some game-breaking bugs and glitches. The second improved the Nightmare mode and cleaned up the menus along with some more fixes and improvements.

This time, there is a more substantial update to be seen. Work started pretty much right after the second update came out, but things got a little frantic once moving out got in the way of things. So, what were supposed to be two smaller updates like we have previously seen, were instead combined into one more medium-sized update.

What's in store? Well, work is still going strong, and obviously things aren't completely finished yet, but here's a quick list on what are just a small snippet of things to come!

[list]
[*] A bunch of new models!
[*] Improvements to the player while running
[*] Improvements to particles, lighting, and more!
[*] Randomized item spawning 👀 
[/list]

Things are also planned for updates beyond this one, and it is exciting to think about where this can take us!

Well, that's it for now, until next time when more concrete details can be shared! Rest assured the game is not abandoned, and that this next update can hopefully bring some much needed life into it! I encourage you to check out X-tefer Productions on Twitter so you don't miss any announcements, from either The Game of Unknown or from other things beyond!
